name: io.github.GeminiGeorge22/http-failure-classifier
title: HTTP Failure Classifier
description: Sorts HTTP failures (timeout, 403, rate limit, TLS, HTML error page) into a stable class.

tools.name: http-failure-classifier
tools.description: HTTP failures arrive as mixed status codes, timeouts, TLS errors, and HTML error pages, so agents cannot decide retry, backoff, or stop from one consistent class. $0.002 per call, USDC via x402 or MPP. Classifies a response snapshot, or one public GET with no credentials, into a retry class with a suggested backoff. An empty call scores a built-in 429 snapshot.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed or observed response

body.description: Response body, or a short prefix; used only to detect HTML error pages

error.description: Transport error message (timeout, TLS, DNS, network)

url.description: Optional public URL to GET once with no credentials and classify
